main_measure.name: mean short-side unusual next-day move (next-day return minus coin's mean daily return, sign flipped)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day grouped

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (cases of one day grouped); reject: t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: the mean short-side unusual move is above 0 with t >= 2 and the larger-|forecast| half beats the smaller half.
reading: Cases are short bets (forecast moving at least 2 points further short from its lowest short level since the last bet, from 0 after flat or a side change) with the coin's mean taken over all next-day returns of all its windows, the t uses per-day summed deviations with a D/(D-1) correction, the median split puts ties in the smaller half, and the situation check uses the adapted regime's three conditions (the profile veto only narrows it).

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01043 on the check folds against +0.01273 on every fold
